entities.name: Free bus ride for women in A.P.: government will have to walk a tightrope
The government will need to compensate the APSRTC for the lost revenue due to free travel for women.
The TDP government intends to provide women of Andhra Pradesh domicile the facility to travel for free within the State on all non-premium buses operated by the APSRTC.
The AP officials estimate that around 25 lakh women will benefit daily from the new scheme, which is expected to impose an additional monthly expenditure of ₹277 crore on the government.
The Karnataka government has announced a 15 % hike in bus fares to offset the revenue losses incurred by the KSRTC on account of the ‘Shakti’
